description: Testing TLS/SSL encryption anywhere on any port

latest_release.name: Version 3.2.5 (bugfix)
latest_release.body:
## TL;DR

* Fix potential injection issues @ $NODE, $PROXY, $XMPP_HOST and $PORT and $dl by providing general validation functions
* Fix a potential format string issue (printf needed '%s') 
* remove eMudhra certificates by updating Linux, Mozilla and Java CA store 
* base docker image updates to supported version
* Improve handling of short-lived certificates
* Be more patient wrt TLS 1.3 session ticket to arrive

---- 
## What's Changed

* Fix broken OpenSSL version check for IPv6 proxy in check_proxy() (#3095) [3.2] by @ericcgu in https://github.com/testssl/testssl.sh/pull/3101
* Improve handling of short-lived certificates (#3097) [3.2 backport] by @ericcgu in https://github.com/testssl/testssl.sh/pull/3106
* Fix timestamp date when --logfile is a dir and other cases by @drwetter in https://github.com/testssl/testssl.sh/pull/3124
* CA store update 2026/08 (3.2) by @drwetter in https://github.com/testssl/testssl.sh/pull/3127
* Declare jsonID by @dcooper16 in https://github.com/testssl/testssl.sh/pull/3130
* Avoid use of color functions and fix SC2021 and SC2171 by @dcooper16 in https://github.com/testssl/testssl.sh/pull/3146
* Introduce early warning function (3.2) by @drwetter in https://github.com/testssl/testssl.sh/pull/3147
* Fix some Shellcheck issues by @dcooper16 in https://github.com/testssl/testssl.sh/pull/3150
* Declare local variables by @dcooper16 in https://github.com/testssl/testssl.sh/pull/3155
* No command line warnings on display only by @dcooper16 in https://github.com/testssl/testssl.sh/pull/3157
* Docker baseimageupdate 3.2 by @drwetter in https://github.com/testssl/testssl.sh/pull/3164
* Fix starttls_io() in 3.2 by @drwetter in https://github.com/testssl/testssl.sh/pull/3167
* Update of macOS runners as GH will soon deprecate MacOS 14 by @drwetter in https://github.com/testssl/testssl.sh/pull/3170
* Fix spki hashgeneration check in t/05_ca_hashes_up_to_date.t (3.2) by @drwetter in https://github.com/testssl/testssl.sh/pull/3184
* Wait for the TLS 1.3 session ticket before closing s_client's stdin by @jvilhuber in https://github.com/testssl/testssl.sh/pull/3188
* Update 3 CA stores to reflect eMudhra "problem" (3.2) by @drwetter in https://github.com/testssl/testssl.sh/pull/3194
* [3.2] Fix Shellcheck issue SC2154 in client-initiated renegotiation check by @Sharawey74 in https://github.com/testssl/testssl.sh/pull/3195
* Validate $NODE, $PROXY, $XMPP_HOST and $PORT (3.2) by @drwetter in https://github.com/testssl/testssl.sh/pull/3202


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/testssl/testssl.sh/compare/v3.2.4...v3.2.5
